observedStrategyFamily.example: Eye of Horus Megaways strategy snippet: start smallest denomination; give game 15 spins to get a win; on a win give 10 more spins for bonus; if no bonus increase stake and repeat.

academicContext.finding: A study of slot-machine vlogs reported progressive betting in 5 of 21 sampled videos and documented creators changing denominations in an attempt to make a machine hit; the paper presents this as a belief that odds can be manipulated, not validated advantage play.

currentSpanishRegulatoryNull.finding: Spanish technical rules require chance events to be governed exclusively by the RNG and state that there must be no correlation between plays except where explicitly contemplated in game rules.
currentSpanishRegulatoryNull.implication: A history-only stake ladder cannot be assumed to alter next-spin probability on a compliant ordinary RNG slot.

operatorCorroboration.finding: bet365 states RNGs have no memory; each spin is a fresh event with identical odds, and the amount staked has no influence on the number the RNG arrives at.
operatorCorroboration.implication: Stake changes alone are not a generic RNG-control mechanism on bet365.

mathNullModel.theorem: If each next spin has the same conditional expected return per euro and payout probabilities scale with stake, any predictable stake schedule based only on past outcomes has expected profit (RTP - 1) times expected total stake.
mathNullModel.sameTurnoverFlatBetComparison: Exactly the same expected net result under the IID scale-invariant null.

realExceptionsWorthResearching.rule: These are not evidence that a ladder ritual works. They are explicit game mechanics and must be verified on the exact current operator/title/configuration before entering an EV model.
